# MailboxValidator

MailboxValidator checks email addresses for syntax, deliverability, mail-server availability, and free or disposable provider status.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/mailboxvalidator/.

## Actions

- **Check Disposable Email** (read-only): Check whether one email address uses a disposable email provider.
- **Check Free Email** (read-only): Check whether one email address uses a free email provider.
- **Validate Email** (read-only): Run comprehensive syntax, domain, mail-server, reputation, and provider checks on one email address.
